subject: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volume & peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volume & peak TPS

Hi Samir —

Thanks for taking the time on the call this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can put together a pricing estimate that aligns with your budget and performance needs.

Recap from our discussion:
- Use case: in-product chat summarization + personalized suggestions for customers (support use case).
- Typical session length: ~400–700 tokens output (model picks/assist responses); prompts average ~150 tokens.
- Critical constraints: sub-200ms p50 on short interactions; ability to handle traffic spikes during peak business hours.

Info we need to confirm for pricing: please reply with the two items below so we can finalize a hosted API estimate:
1) Expected monthly token volume (approximate range is fine).
2) Expected peak throughput in requests-per-second (peak TPS) — will help size dedicated concurrency vs. burst plans.

As a reference point, attached is a preliminary pricing estimate based on the ranges you mentioned on the call. We modeled three scenarios with different batching/cache assumptions and an approximate target unit price goal of $/1M tokens (you mentioned a target in the call).

Next steps once you confirm volumes/peak TPS:
- I'll share a final hosted pricing sheet and a recommended plan (self-serve vs. reserved capacity)
- Offer a 2-week proof-of-concept with $1,000 credit so you can validate p50/p95 latencies in your environment
- If procurement needs documentation, we can loop in Marissa for contract/terms and provide SOC2 evidence.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (1 page summary)

Thanks — looking forward to your numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volume & peak TPS

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the recap — good summary. Quick answers below:

1) Expected monthly token volume: we expect to start at ~12M tokens/month (month 1–3) and grow to ~20M tokens/month over the next 6–9 months if adoption is good. We can comfortably commit to a 12–20M monthly band for now.

2) Peak TPS: our busiest window is during US business hours with occasional spikes from 2–4 TPS sustained for a few minutes; on very rare marketing surge events we could see short spikes up to ~10 TPS for <1 minute. The steady-state peak to plan for is 4 TPS.

Budget: high level — the product team was looking for a ballpark of $2k–$6k/month to start; they also asked if there’s a meaningful discount for committing to a minimum monthly token volume.

Let me know if you need any more detail (avg session counts per user, org size, etc.). Happy to provide a short telemetry export if that helps.

Cheers,
Samir Patel
Head of Product, FintechCo
samir.patel@fintechco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volume & peak TPS

Great, Samir — that’s really helpful.

Implications of the numbers you provided:
- 12–20M tokens/month aligns with our mid-tier hosted plans. With automated prefix caching and batching tuned for your session sizes, we should be able to get to competitive unit economics.
- Peak plan: design for steady 4 TPS with headroom for 10 TPS short spikes — we typically recommend a burst-enabled pool for those marketing events so you don’t pay for reserved concurrency for rare spikes.
- Discounting: yes — we can offer a stepped discount for a committed minimum (e.g., commit to 12M/mo for 6 months and we’ll apply a blended unit price target). I’ll work up numbers and share a formal quote.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send a tailored hosted pricing quote by EOD tomorrow with three options: pay-as-you-go, 6-month commit (12M/mo), and 12-month commit (20M/mo).
2) If your procurement wants contract language, Marissa can pick that up (cc’d).
3) We can spin up a proof tenant and apply a $1,000 credit for a 2-week performance validation — want to tentatively schedule that for next week?

Can you confirm whether procurement prefers a single consolidated PO for platform + usage or separate monthly invoices for usage? That will affect billing cadence.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the quote.

Best,
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechco.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volume & peak TPS

Hi Samir —

Happy to help on the procurement side. A few notes for your team to consider so we can keep the procurement loop tight:
- Contracting: we can support a 6- or 12-month committed usage agreement with monthly true-ups.
- Invoicing: we typically issue a monthly invoice for committed portion and a usage invoice for overages; if you prefer a consolidated monthly invoice we can accommodate that — please confirm preference.
- SOC2 / security docs: I’ll attach our standard security pack (SOC2 report, data processing addendum) once you confirm which procurement contact to send to.

Samir — if procurement wants to proceed, please share the contact name and preferred PO/billing details and we’ll prepare the SOW/Order Form.

Thanks —
